serverUrl.title: Usage server
serverUrl.description: The collection server's address (https://host). Empty: no server, export only. It must be at a host the extension's manifest allows (host_permissions). An agent's own setting under Settings, Advanced still wins.

serverToken.title: Upload token
serverToken.description: The upload token for that server (or for TNI's central server when no server is set). Never shown in the panel.

aiOn.title: Suggest answers
aiOn.description: Default for Settings, AI, Suggest answers. The agent can change it.

lunaAuto.title: Put checked picks in
lunaAuto.description: Default for Settings, AI, Put checked picks in. The agent can change it.

agent.title: Initials
agent.description: The agent's initials (1 to 6 letters or digits), for a computer one agent uses. The agent's own initials in Settings still win.
